title: Noctune Agent Task
description: A single task entry in the agent queue. Validated by the runner before execution.

type.description: Task type — determines prompt template and acceptance schema

description.description: Detailed description of what the task should accomplish

priority.description: Priority score 0–100. Higher = more urgent. Picker returns highest first.

items.description: File path relative to repo root that this task may modify
File path relative to repo root that this task may read but not modify

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria — each line is a checkable condition

checklist_items.description: Checklist item IDs to tick on successful completion, e.g. ["q1-queue-seed"]

intentionally_changed_views.description: Screenshot view names intentionally changed by this task (screenshot diff exemption)

max_loc.description: Maximum lines of code change allowed per task type limits

max_files.description: Maximum number of files this task may touch

needs_split.description: If true, curator must split before execution

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last status change
